## Description {#details}

<p>C++ header file with inline implementations for the µTest++ test hierarchy.</p>


<p>This header provides the inline and template implementations for the test hierarchy used within the µTest++ framework: the accessors of the base classes, the constructors that bind the callable objects and their arguments, the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">test()</span> methods that create and run subtests, and the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">expect()</span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">assume()</span> checks.</p>


<p>When additional arguments are given, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">std::bind</span> is used to pre-bind them, allowing versatile test initialisation with arbitrary callable types and arguments. A <span class="doxyComputerOutput">static_suite</span> additionally registers itself with its <span class="doxyComputerOutput">static_runner</span> upon construction.</p>


<p>All definitions reside within the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus">micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus</a></span> namespace, maintaining a clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.</p>


<p>The header files are organised within the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus</span> folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.</p>


<p>This file is intended solely for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Portable <span class="doxyComputerOutput">printf()</span> conversion for <span class="doxyComputerOutput">size_t</span> values in trace messages.</p>


<p>Clang's format checker on Windows (the "ms_printf" archetype) rejects the standard <span class="doxyComputerOutput">z</span> modifier, even though the UCRT <span class="doxyComputerOutput">printf()</span> implementation supports it at run time, so the Microsoft-specific <span class="doxyComputerOutput">I</span> modifier is used there instead (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">"Iu"</span>); elsewhere it is <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"zu"</span>. Defined only when <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-config/#ga27bb1b9066b162d868e0b1c557b91e0d">MICRO_OS_PLUS_MICRO_TEST_PLUS_TRACE_CONSTRUCTORS_ENABLED</a></span> is defined.</p>


<p>Definition at line <a href="#l00079">79</a> of file <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/inlines/test-inlines-h">test-inlines.h</a>.</p>
